title: MAK95 MCQ Five-Gate Closure and Cluster Governance
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Promote safety rules into executable DAG nodes, not prose-only constraints
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume
Every high-risk write, sync, or release node must declare observable acceptance criteria
Preserve stable row identity across markdown, CSV, ledger, batch JSON, result JSON, and merge dry-run

metadata.outcome: Identity-preserving MCQ closure with route-specific branches and bounded validation retries

nodes.title: Load MCQ corpus, ledgers, and batch schema
nodes.content: Read MCQ markdown/CSV sources, latest five-gate ledger, batch JSON, assigned result path, and validator command.

nodes.title: Establish stable row identity inventory
nodes.content: Record every original row ID and expected one-output-per-input-row closure contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Every batch row has stable ID, source, and expected output slot

nodes.title: Lock result schema and gate vocabulary
nodes.content: Define valid gate enum, closure statuses, terminal/manual reason codes, and validator command provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate taxonomy is exhaustive, ordered, and machine-readable

nodes.title: Deduplicate and cluster stems/options
nodes.content: Normalize stems/options, cluster keyed-answer variants, and group by subtopic/frontmatter plus semantic near-duplicates.

nodes.title: Audit overclustering and keyed-answer conflicts
nodes.content: Compute singleton count, duplicate groups, keyed-answer conflicts, and suspicious merges.
acceptanceCriteria: Keyed-answer conflicts are split or flagged

nodes.title: Build PageIndex citation bank per cluster
nodes.content: Collect PageIndex anchors and local evidence banks for clusters likely to need grounding.
acceptanceCriteria: Citation anchors include document ID/page and review status

nodes.title: Route each row through five gates
nodes.content: For each MCQ row, classify as repairable, needs citation-bank grounding, duplicate merge, terminal placeholder, or manual review.
acceptanceCriteria: Every row receives exactly one preliminary gate route
Rows needing manual or terminal closure include controlled reason code

nodes.title: Audit route completeness and reason codes
nodes.content: Verify exactly one closure route per row and controlled reasons for terminal/manual rows.
acceptanceCriteria: All terminal/manual reasons use controlled vocabulary

nodes.title: Ground only rows classified as needs-grounding
nodes.content: Prefer PageIndex page anchors and local evidence banks over generic web citations; do not ground duplicate/terminal/manual-only rows unnecessarily.

nodes.title: Write bounded result JSON only
nodes.content: Write the assigned result file without editing ledgers or canonical CSVs; include every original batch row or a valid terminal/manual status.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one output record per input row

nodes.title: Run validator
nodes.content: Run the supplied five-gate result validator and capture errors as structured reroute tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator passes or emits bounded retry plan

nodes.title: Bounded retry or terminal escalation
nodes.content: Validator errors feed targeted reroute/repair with max attempts, then terminal/manual escalation.
acceptanceCriteria: Retry count and terminal escalation reasons are recorded

nodes.title: Run merge dry-run only after validation
nodes.content: Dry-run merge/fast-closure before any canonical mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: No ledger mutation occurs before approval

edges.description: every result must preserve original row identity
gating uses controlled taxonomy and precedence
validator failures become bounded repair tasks or terminal escalation
